children: Midnight City plans to enable AI agent trading on its platform in Q4 2026.

The proposed feature connects Midnight's privacy focus with AI-agent trading, putting the two themes within the same planned platform offering. If delivered, agent activity would flow through NIGHT-derived fee capacity, creating a potential link between platform use and demand tied to the token. That is the mechanism behind the event's speculative demand thesis, rather than interest in AI agents alone. The announcement describes a planned capability, so the demand case depends on both delivery and subsequent agent trading activity, not simply the availability of the feature.

title: Midnight: Midnight City plans to enable AI agent trading - Q4 2026
